name: aster
description: Aster - an auditable, Windows-only local agent harness optimized for practical functionality (v1.0)

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run architecture:check && npm run capabilities:check
scripts.desktop: tsc -b tsconfig.json && node tools/build-desktop-app.mjs && node node_modules/electron/cli.js packages/desktop/dist/app/main.mjs
scripts.desktop-selfcheck: tsc -b tsconfig.json && node tools/build-desktop-app.mjs && node node_modules/electron/cli.js packages/desktop/dist/app/main.mjs --self-check
scripts.desktop-portable: tsc -b tsconfig.json && node tools/build-desktop-app.mjs && node tools/build-desktop-portable.mjs
